body:
## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none
- Open blockers: none
- Proposal readiness: direction sufficiently valuable, bounded and feasible for authorized Design authoring.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop; Design is the next eligible owning stage.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: approval covers the proposal direction only. It does not approve a deletion inventory, detailed engineering behavior, delivery allocation, implementation, adoption, verification, branch readiness or publication.

## Review Dimensions

- Challenge: pass. Fragmented delivery ownership and the concrete build-skills.py default versus supported Codex placement establish a material reconciliation problem without attributing the local installation to an unproved actor.
- Goals: pass. One accessible owner, supported-target coherence and preserved integrity/local-state protection describe outcomes rather than a prescribed implementation.
- Scope: pass. All four requested outcomes remain mandatory within one initiative; cleanup is bounded to distribution, installation and OpenCode retirement, with shared consumers explicitly included.
- Governing principle: pass. One delivery owner preserves separate construction, local-write permission and publication authority.
- Direction: pass. Combined Distribution has a coherent canonical-source-to-installed-environment boundary; Skill retains content ownership and Release retains publication and public evidence ownership.
- Feasibility: pass. The single embedded Feasibility assessment is supported by System/FU-013, the current adapter manifest and CLI mapping, installation guidance, generator default, and existing installer/lockfile safeguards. Unknown consumers and unsafe state transitions block affected retirement, not the bounded direction decision.
- Material impact: pass. The intentional public compatibility break, reduced supported audience, historical-package limits and Release versioning dependency are disclosed in impact and requested decision.
- Vision alignment: pass; aligned. One inspectable contract, preservation of decision/proof meaning, safe supported delivery and explicit subsequent review reinforce traceable and reviewable engineering. Vision does not commit to OpenCode or a fixed adapter count.
- Downstream authority: pass. Design owns exact surviving-clause/decision/consumer mappings, support-transition behavior and script dispositions. Delivery owns sequencing and concrete proof. No uninspected deletion or publication is authorized here.
- Requested decision: pass. The combined model, source retirement, OpenCode withdrawal and bounded script cleanup are explicit, including compatibility acceptance and safety limits.

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass. Make the model and retire superseded documents are core work; OpenCode removal and stale-script removal are separate implementation slices within this initiative. Shared consumers are same-slice dependencies. None of the four original goals is deferred, rejected or silently narrowed. Historical evidence and unrelated local/user files are explicitly outside blanket deletion.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve the direction for subsequent authorized Design. Reconcile the Release three-target population, old managed-state handling, retained-target obligations and real script consumers during Design before retiring their sources. These are explicitly assigned downstream obligations, not unresolved proposal findings.

## Specialized-gate group

- Active gate predicates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false.
- Gate outcomes: scope budget passes. Core work, same-slice dependencies and separate implementation slices have explicit treatments and outcomes; no hidden follow-up or missing standing authority.
- Trigger ambiguity: none.

## Durable-recording group

- Recording status: recorded through review record; successful persistence is required before relying on this judgment.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Record path: docs/changes/2026-09-10-distribution-model-and-opencode-retirement/reviews/proposal-review.json
- Finding-record paths: none.

## Formal-review group

- Review ID: proposal-review
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-10-distribution-model-and-opencode-retirement/reviews/proposal-review.json
- Governed change identity: 2026-09-10-distribution-model-and-opencode-retirement
- Classification: formal-lifecycle/manual; durable_recording_context=true; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
- Independence: the separate distribution-proposal-reviewer agent inspected the proposal and evidence and authored only this review. The proposal contribution was authored by the parent distribution-proposal-author agent; the reviewer did not edit it. A fresh role label alone is not the independence basis.
- Evidence scope: complete proposal and current standing vision/constitution; bounded sections of linked System and Release owners, FU-013, installer/lockfile/invocation contracts, and direct manifest/install-guide/CLI-mapping/generator inspection. The proposal's direct-evidence no-map rationale is accepted for this area. No inventory-wide deletion audit, runtime test or final Verify is claimed. Original intent is durably captured in the proposal's four-row initial-intent treatment.
